reminder_has_trip.email_heading: Your trip is right where you left it.
reminder_has_trip.email_intro: is saved and waiting. Here is what it already has:
reminder_has_trip.email_preheader: The route is saved. Add your bookings and the plan comes together on its own.
reminder_has_trip.email_public_note: You can show the finished plan to anyone: a public link opens the trip with its map and route in any browser, no sign-up needed. Private documents stay hidden.
reminder_has_trip.email_step1_desc: stays, flights, trains, activities. No need to type them: “Scan booking” takes the confirmation text, a booking reference, a link, a PDF or a screenshot.
reminder_has_trip.email_step1_title: Add the bookings you already have
reminder_has_trip.email_step2_desc: Triplanio flags a night with no place to stay and any leg of the route with no transfer.
reminder_has_trip.email_step3_desc: one link, and everyone plans in a shared space — with an assistant in the group chat that knows this route.
reminder_no_trip.email_heading: No trip yet. Shall we start with two fields?
reminder_no_trip.email_intro: Cities and dates are all Triplanio needs to become useful. The route on the map, the calendar and the day-by-day plan build themselves — after that you just add bookings.
reminder_no_trip.email_item1_desc: cities, stays and transfers in one clear route.
reminder_no_trip.email_item2_desc: transfers, check-ins and activities laid out by the hour.
reminder_no_trip.email_item3_desc: a booking has a price, so it's already an expense, in its own category.
reminder_no_trip.email_item4_desc: tickets, vouchers and insurance live inside the trip.
reminder_no_trip.email_note_ai: You don't have to fill anything in by hand: on a booking, hit “Scan booking”, paste the confirmation text or upload a PDF or a screenshot — Triplanio pulls out the dates, codes and prices itself.
reminder_no_trip.email_note_simple: A trip can be very simple: a weekend in one city is still a route, a map and a budget.
reminder_no_trip.email_preheader: Cities and dates — the route, map and day-by-day plan build themselves.
reminder_no_trip.email_subject: Your first trip takes a minute
trip_telegram_unlinked.text: The Telegram assistant has been disconnected from this trip - reminders will no longer be sent.
welcome.email_ai1_body: Connect the assistant to a trip in its settings and it will remind you about what matters: the end of free hotel cancellation, an upcoming check-out, a flight, the next event. It will also tell you how ready the trip is and answer any question about it in a private chat.
welcome.email_ai2_body: Booked a transfer or a hotel? Upload the file, a screenshot or the confirmation text: Triplanio will pick out addresses, prices, times and everything else itself.
welcome.email_ai3_body: A separate trip chat for all companions, with the assistant in it. Tag it any time and it will answer your question or suggest something.
welcome.email_ai4_body: The assistant will suggest cities and a route and prepare a draft you can then adapt to yourself.
welcome.email_budget_note: The trip budget fills up automatically as you add bookings, and the currency converter brings expenses in any currency to the budget's main currency. Pro adds manual budget control and manual exchange-rate correction.
welcome.email_intro: All that's left is to create your first trip. Build it with the assistant or on your own by entering cities and dates. Bookings, plans, budget and everything important now live in one place, and the assistant helps with planning and reminds you about what matters.
welcome.email_preheader: All that's left is to create your first trip.
welcome.email_step1_desc: Enter cities and dates: the trip gets a map, a calendar, a timeline and a budget, and it shows up in your travel stats.
welcome.email_step2_desc: Add hotel, transfer and activity bookings, and so on. Everything now lives in one place, and the readiness status shows what is still missing.
welcome.email_step2_title: Add the bookings you already have
welcome.email_step3_desc: Not travelling alone? Invite companions by sending an email invitation or sharing a link. Everyone plans in one place and sees every change.
